classes.name: ypy-optimistic
classes.description: Applied to the optimistic nodes while the request is in flight.

attributes.name: ypy-optimistic
attributes.description: Shows the result of the request before the server answers and puts the page back if it fails. The value is a selector of a `<template>` or element to clone, `remove`, or the name of a function registered with `ypy.optimistic.register`. `false` turns it off.

values.name: false
values.description: No optimistic change for this element.

attributes.name: ypy-optimistic-target
attributes.description: Where the optimistic change goes, instead of the target of the request. Takes a selector or an extended selector.

attributes.name: ypy-optimistic-swap
attributes.description: How the optimistic content is put in, instead of the swap style of the request (`innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `beforeend`, `delete`...).

events.name: ypy:optimistic:applied
events.description: The optimistic change was made. Cancel it to undo the change at once.

events.name: ypy:optimistic:confirmed
events.description: The server accepted the request. The server's content replaces the optimistic one where they meet; elsewhere the optimistic content stays.

events.name: ypy:optimistic:rolledback
events.description: The page was put back: `reason` is `status`, `error`, `aborted` or `cancelled`.
